How much to use
Your doctor will determine the correct dosage to use, depending on your medical condition.
How long to use it
Your doctor will tell you how often you will require treatment with this medicine.
If you are given too much (overdose)
Immediately telephone your doctor, or the Poisons Information Centre (telephone 13 11 26) if you think you may have been given too much Xeomin. Do this even if there are no signs of discomfort or poisoning.
You may need urgent medical attention.
Symptoms of an overdose may include:
• general weakness, • drooping of the upper eyelid, • double vision, • difficulty in breathing, • difficulty in speaking, • difficulty in swallowing.
